entries.metricMeaning: RUN_M is the horizontal tread depth of one step, not flight run or step rise.
Only a reviewed one-way, non-switchback ramp; do not apply 0.9 m to a two-flight ramp.
Only the clear ramp width dimension; landing dimensions and all other ramp conditions remain separate.
Human must confirm short-distance, one-way movement and designated accessible route. Article 14 paragraph 2 permits an alternative designated route; do not apply this rule to every corridor.
Article 22 dimension only; articles 17 and 20 can impose different or stronger contextual requirements. Do not resolve precedence by choosing the smaller threshold.
Article 22 entrance dimension only; article 13 and public-building conditions require separate review.
Only a door of the designated accessible WC. Outward opening, safety hardware and number of accessible cabins are not checked.
Door of a human-designated accessible lift only; not all lift doors. Article 9 permits at least one qualifying lift where multiple lifts serve the rise.
One axis of the required 1.5 x 1.5 m level platform. Does not prove its depth or level surface. Multiple-entrance selection must be confirmed by a human.
Other independent horizontal axis of the required platform. RUN_M is clear platform depth, not route length or width.
Only a vestibule that exists and has confirmed same-direction external and internal doors. RUN_M is clear vestibule depth.
Only confirmed external and internal doors both opening into the vestibule; do not assume the same-direction case.
RISE_M is the actual threshold height above adjacent finished floor, not total door height. A confirmed absent threshold is zero; missing evidence is not zero.

Standard branch only, explicitly confirmed by a human; not a universal cap for exceptional ramps. SLOPE_RATIO is rise/run: 5 percent is 0.05, not 5 or degrees. Exception branch remains a separate blocked evaluator.
Business-class door only; not a public-building door (which has a different minimum in the same paragraph). Door width and opening direction remain separate checks.
Requires scoped multi-input evaluation; see missingCapabilities.
